evaluation.primary_selection_score: unweighted macro mean of all three metrics on frozen dev
evaluation.tie_rule: exact numerical ties choose the documented default because it is easier to explain
evaluation.later_system_comparison: paired bootstrap on every metric with all system-search and baseline-search opportunities included in selection-aware correction

existing_locked_runs.lead: reuse A1 document_order frozen-dev artifact after exact ID, config-length, evaluator, and prediction-integrity validation
existing_locked_runs.random: reuse A1 seed-3407 frozen-dev artifact after the same validation

selection.pacsum_tfidf: highest dev macro among its 21 preregistered candidates
selection.pacsum_sbert: highest dev macro among its 21 preregistered candidates
selection.sbert_mmr: highest dev macro among its 5 preregistered candidates
selection.gate2_adversarial_baseline: highest dev macro among every completed baseline candidate, including locked Lead and Random
selection.failed_candidates: remain comparison opportunities and are never silently removed from the search log

promotion.dev_test: forbidden in this study; only the final proposed configuration and dev-selected baseline finalists may be evaluated once after Gate 2 and selector comparison are complete

sources.memsum_scope_decision: MemSum is reported separately as a trained GovReport-domain model, not mixed into the primary no-task-training baseline family
